definitions.explanation: The technique of photographing a subject from very close range, capturing fine details. Also used as a suru verb.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{接写|せっしゃ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I took a close-up photo of the flower.

examples.japanese: {接写|せっしゃ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{細部|さいぶ}→細部：20562_saibu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: With close-up photography, you can see the fine details of insects.

examples.japanese: {接写|せっしゃ}⟦モード→モード：11596_moodo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}えて→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: I switched to macro mode and then took photos of the food.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {接|せつ} (close, contact) + {写|しゃ} (photograph). Used in photography to describe shooting at very close range. The English equivalent "macro photography" is more technical, while {接写|せっしゃ} is used more broadly for any close-up shot.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {接写|せっしゃ}⟦モード→モード：11596_moodo⟧ (close-up/macro mode)
- {接写|せっしゃ}⟦レンズ→レンズ：07808_renzu⟧ (macro lens)
- {接写|せっしゃ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to take a close-up photo)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- マクロ⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧: macro photography — the loanword equivalent, more technical
- ⟦{広角|こうかく}→広角：17788_koukaku⟧: wide-angle — captures a broader view (opposite approach)
